/bin/bash -lc "cat > dashboard-check.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'

const hooks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  state: undefined as any,
  effect: undefined as undefined | (() => void | (() => void)),
}))

vi.mock('react', async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import('react')>()),
  useState: (initial: unknown) => [hooks.state ?? initial, (value: unknown) => { hooks.state = value }],
  useEffect: (effect: typeof hooks.effect) => { hooks.effect = effect },
}))

import Dashboard from './app/Dashboard'

beforeEach(() => { hooks.state = undefined; hooks.effect = undefined })
afterEach(() => { vi.unstubAllGlobals() })

it('starts all requests together and displays their responses', async () => {
  const resolvers: Array<(response: Response) => void> = []
  const fetchMock = vi.fn(() => new Promise<Response>((resolve) => resolvers.push(resolve)))
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)
  expect(renderToStaticMarkup(Dashboard())).toContain('Loading dashboard data')
  hooks.effect"'!()
  expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.map((call) => call[0])).toEqual(['"'/api/analytics', '/api/notifications', '/api/settings'])
  resolvers.forEach((resolve, index) => resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ value: index }), { status: 200 })))
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(hooks.state?.status).toBe('success'))
  const html = renderToStaticMarkup(Dashboard())
  for (const label of ['Analytics', 'Notifications', 'Settings']) expect(html).toContain(label)
  for (const value of [0, 1, 2]) expect(html).toContain("'`"value": ${value}`)
})

it('"'reports unsuccessful HTTP responses and aborts the remaining requests', async () => {
  const fetchMock = vi.fn((url: string) => url === '/api/analytics'
    ? Promise.resolve(new Response('', { status: 500 }))
    : new Promise<Response>(() => {}))
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)
  Dashboard()
  hooks.effect"'!()
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(hooks.state?.status).toBe('"'error'))
  expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][1].signal.aborted).toBe(true)
  expect(renderToStaticMarkup(Dashboard())).toContain('Unable to load dashboard data')
})

it('does not update state after cleanup', async () => {
  const resolvers: Array<(response: Response) => void> = []
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(() => new Promise<Response>((resolve) => resolvers.push(resolve))))
  Dashboard()
  const cleanup = hooks.effect"'!() as () => void
  cleanup()
  resolvers.forEach((resolve) => resolve(new Response('"'{}', { status: 200 })))
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10))
  expect(hooks.state).toBeUndefined()
})
EOF
npx vitest run dashboard-check.test.tsx"
